name: Poké Ball
desc: A standard ball for catching wild Pokémon.

name: Potion
desc: Restores 12% of max HP instantly, then 12% at the end of each of the next 2 turns. Only one healing mist at a time — the strongest active one wins.

name: Super Potion
desc: Restores 24% of max HP instantly, then 24% at the end of each of the next 2 turns. Only one healing mist at a time — the strongest active one wins.

name: Hyper Potion
desc: Restores 48% of max HP instantly, then 48% at the end of each of the next 2 turns. Only one healing mist at a time — the strongest active one wins.

name: Max Potion
desc: Fully restores HP of one Pokémon.

name: Full Restore
desc: Fully restores HP & cures status.

name: Full Heal
desc: Cures all status conditions.

name: Max Elixir
desc: Fully restores PP of all moves.
